monitors.name: Nightcap daily spend fraction
monitors.message: Daily ledger spend is at or above 80% of RATE_LIMIT_DAILY_SPEND_USD. The fraction includes Places and Routes. No notification channel is attached.

monitors.name: Nightcap request error rate
monitors.message: The app request error rate over the last hour is at or above 10%. Typed pipeline failures count when the HTTP status stays 200. No notification channel is attached.
